svg.title: Prepare solution B · sample B
svg.desc: Dissolve 1.142 g cadmium chloride 2.5-hydrate and 2.482 g sodium thiosulfate pentahydrate in the mixed solvent of 23 mL 99% isopropyl alcohol and 77 mL doubly distilled water. Mixing order within this solution and dissolution time are not specified. Source-bound concept; apparatus geometry illustrative, not measured.
